passages.note: Bill details page lists Raatz as a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 and digests its parental-notification requirement.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Stacey Donato, Sen. Jeff Raatz, Sen. Gary Byrne.

passages.note: Senate roll call shows Raatz voting Yea on final passage of HB 1608.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 37 Education matters. Nay 12 Excused 1 Not Voting 0

passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled act text creates the new parental-notification chapter requiring written notice whenever a student requests a name or pronoun change.

rows.reasoning: Sen. Jeff Raatz co-sponsored HB 1608 (2023) and voted Yea on its final Senate passage; the enacted chapter requires a school to notify a parent in writing of any student request to change name or pronoun, with no exception for staff belief of danger, matching the rung 'Require staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school.'
